Chatbot

A chatbot is a program you talk to in natural language. Modern chatbots run on LLMs; older ones followed fixed scripts with canned answers.

Example

Your bank’s support chat that answers card questions is a chatbot. ChatGPT is one that covers almost any topic.

Related terms

  • Large Language Model (LLM)
  • System Prompt
  • AI Agent
